entries.name: Delikat Genusshandwerk
entries.description: Mediterranean and Austrian cuisines, tapas, nicely cooked local dishes. Small gourmet shop and restaurant in the heart of Kötschach-Mauthen.

entries.name: Landgasthof Pfeffermühle
entries.description: Traditional family business for over 40 years, situated between Kötschach and Mauthen. Down-to-earth, genuine Carinthian cooking in a homely, laid-back atmosphere.

entries.name: Gasthof Edelweiss
entries.description: Real biergarten close to an old hotel with good food in a comfortable, relaxing and surprising court. Traditional Austrian inn.

entries.name: Cafe-Restaurant Reiter
entries.description: Local cafe-restaurant in Kötschach-Mauthen serving Austrian classics.

entries.name: Familie Eduard Engl Speck und Reid'n
entries.description: Traditional Carinthian family restaurant known for local cured meats (Speck) and specialties.

entries.name: Plöckenhaus
entries.description: Mountain restaurant at the Plöcken Pass, hearty Carinthian fare with panoramic alpine views.

entries.name: Sissys Sonnleitners Landhaus Kellerwand
entries.description: Local guesthouse and restaurant serving traditional Carinthian cuisine in a rustic setting.
